title: Lost Vape Thelema Elite S Pod Vape Kit
description: The Lost Vape Thelema Elite S Pod Kit is a compact, high-performance MTL (mouth-to-lung) device built for vapers who value simplicity, style, and control. Powered by a built-in 1400mAh battery, it delivers consistent output and long-lasting performance, with USB-C fast charging ensuring you're ready to go with minimal downtime. Designed with both ease-of-use and versatility in mind, the Elite S features two operating modes. Eco Mode offers a more power-efficient experience with the E Plus Dual Mesh pod’s single mesh coil configuration, while Turbo Mode activates the pod’s dual coil setup to increase vapour output. A simple two-click toggle lets you switch modes on the fly, and draw-activation offers an intuitive alternative to using the firing button. Compatible with Lost Vape’s E Plus pod series, including the 0.6ohm Dual Mesh Pod included, this kit delivers a customisable MTL experience with an adjustable airflow slider to refine each draw just the way you like. The advanced internal E-Core Tech 3.0 coil structure enhances vapour production and flavour accuracy, making it ideal for extracting the maximum flavour from nic salts or 50/50 freebase e-liquids. The Thelema Elite S pairs its exceptional performance with an ergonomic chassis. Its compact form is enhanced by a textured grip panel, available in stylish finishes such as denim or faux leather, depending on the colourway. Comfortable to use, stylish and packed with intuitive features, the Thelema Elite S offers a refined MTL vape experience in a highly portable form – an excellent choice for both newer vapers and those seeking a dependable everyday pod kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
